prompts.name: language
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one small Android settings menu icon, designed to be recognizable at 32dp. Style: premium friendly soft 3D molded glossy plastic, gently rounded sculptural edges, subtle bevels and restrained highlights, like colorful polished mobile utility app icons. Near frontal three-quarter view, slight tilt, key light from upper left. Composition: exactly ONE centered isolated icon occupying about 75% of a square canvas, generous transparent margin, cohesive simple silhouette, minimal details. Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no opaque square, no checkerboard pattern, no scene or floor. Only a very subtle tight shadow on the object itself. No decorative sparkles, no surrounding objects, no captions, no watermarks. Subject: a rich sky-blue globe with a few clean white meridian and equator bands, conveying languages and worldwide communication. Simple spherical globe, no stand, no continents, no letters.
